text:
alice: Pager fired for us-west-2; spike in 5xx and KV miss rate across rope-backed endpoints. Dashboards: https://app.redwood/ops/d/prefetch?orgId=1&var-cluster=us-west-2. Notable: continuous-batch token latency jumped ~4x, tail CPU on rope nodes up. 

oncall-bot: Incident INC-2026 assigned to ben (pager). Priority: high. Automatic runbook suggestion: KV-prefetch-thundering.

ben: I'm on pager. Checking rope pool and KV metrics now. Can everyone drop any recent deploys?

chandra: We shipped the longctx/NTK sliding-window change to longctx-v2 yesterday around 21:14 UTC (small canary). YaRN sliding-window default window_ms increased from 200 -> 800 for better longprefetch. Might be related.

maria: Confirming deploys: only longctx-v2 touched rope routing + YaRN window. No other service changes.

ben: Looking at logs: high KV load from continuous-batch paths. Lots of partial hits and heavy prefix eviction churn (eviction rate spike). Sample log snippet: 
``` 
kv_store eviction: key_prefix=rope/longctx/ntk_4096 ttl_ms=0 reason=cache_pressure
batcher: continuous_enqueue tokens=1200 req_id=abc123 latency_ms=2400
rope: allocate_kv_cache miss_count=6421 hit_count=112
```

alice: Customer-facing impact: several chat endpoints for a handful of enterprise tenants showing increased latency and occasional 5xx. CS alerted. Need quick mitigation and comms.

ben: Priorities: 1) stop the thrash (reduce prefetch / disable sliding window) 2) reduce continuous batch sizes so we stop creating huge KV footprints 3) scale rope pool temporarily if needed. I'll attempt non-disruptive runtime changes first.

chandra: Agreed. Hotpatch plan: 
- disable YaRN sliding-window (toggle) 
- cap continuous_batch.max_tokens to 256 (from 1024) 
- enable aggressive prefix caching TTL to 30s for rope longctx keys

maria: I'll prepare commands. Proposed commands: 
``` 
# disable sliding window
redwoodctl runtime set --cluster us-west-2 --service yarn --key sliding_window.enabled --value false
# cap continuous batching
redwoodctl runtime set --cluster us-west-2 --service batcher --key continuous_batch.max_tokens --value 256
# set prefix TTL
redwoodctl runtime set --cluster us-west-2 --service kv --key rope_prefix_ttl_sec --value 30
```

ben: Applying in that order and will watch. I'll do a canary on 10% of nodes first.

(2m later) ben: Canary applied to 12 nodes. Initial metrics: eviction rate down ~40%, KV miss rate trending down. 5xx still elevated but tail latency improving.

maria: Rolling the rest out now. Patch rolling with 30s staggered restarts to avoid stampede.

(4m later) ben: Full hotpatch rolled. 5xx steadily falling toward baseline. Continuous-batch token sizes observed down to <300 on average. CPU on rope nodes reduced ~25%.

alice: Great. CS update: send initial note saying mitigations in flight, some customers impacted but trending to recovery. Use canned message: "We observed a transient routing/cache regression impacting latency for some customers in us-west-2; mitigation applied, watching recovery."

chandra: Root cause hypothesis: the longctx-v2 change increased average NTK and widened YaRN sliding window, which increased prefetch radius and caused KV working set growth; combined with continuous-batch defaulting to large token max created a working-set that outgrew KV cache eviction policy -> eviction storms and thrash.

ben: Agreed. Next steps (short): revert sliding-window increase in longctx config or ship an adjusted heuristic. Create follow-up ticket to tune batching heuristics.

maria: Creating follow-up issue: RW-ops#7923 - "longctx-v2: NTK/YaRN window tuning and batching protection" with required owners @chandra @runtime-team.

sre-rotation: On-call handoff in 1 hour. ben, please hand off monitoring and any rollback notes.

ben: Handing off: hotpatch applied at 2169990180, full rollout at 2169990300. Observed incident duration ~10m peak; 5xx peaked at +3.2% above baseline. Mitigation: disabled sliding-window, capped continuous_batch.max_tokens=256, set rope_prefix_ttl=30s. No infra changes needed beyond runtime config.

maria: I'll watch for 2h and escalate to chandra if we see re-rise. Setting a synthetic check to alert if 5xx > 1.5x baseline for 10m.

alice: Filing customer impact summary and tagging accounts hit. Will prepare post-incident note after root cause ticket triaged. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:

oncall-bot: Incident INC-2026 status: mitigated -> monitoring. Assigned to maria for 4-hour watch. Next update due in 45m.

ben: Handoff done. Leaving notes in the incident doc and pager history.

maria: I have the watch. Will update if any regression.

chandra: Follow-up dev action: implement batching safety guard (reject or fallback to small batches if KV miss ratio > 0.2) and add canary thresholds for NTK window increases.

alice: Closing thread for immediate action; keeping incident doc open for RCA.
